claim: The no-unused-exports check says a value is named by nothing, by only a test, or by only its own file. None of the three tells a road taken out on purpose from a wire come loose, and across the trees swept in one day the loose wires were common enough that acting on the check alone would have taken live behaviour away. A writer whose readers remain, a guard nothing calls, a call a live refusal names, a parser for a file still beside a page, and data every page of a type carries that nothing reads all read to the check exactly as dead code reads. The sorting test is what a live path expects, and the check cannot answer it.

evidence:
Swept 2026-09-14 across alan, pages, agents, story, personas, infrastructure, code, checks, changes, domains, temper, utils and testing-system, taking the refusals from 1272 to 210. Each case below was established by reading the code as it is.

A WRITER WHOSE READERS REMAIN. `agent/seat/session/modules/seat-rotated-session/seat-rotated-session.module.code.ts:22` `keepRotated` is the only writer of `rotated-session-uuid`. Three live paths read it and one clears it. Read by three, cleared by one, written by none.

A GUARD NOTHING CALLS. `page/modules/live-store-write-guard/live-store-write-guard.module.code.ts:22` `refuseALiveTestWriteIn` would refuse a test writing into Alan's own checkout. Its three original callers went with the markdown page writer at `897c8d4a5ee`. The module around it is alive, because `test-run-marking` still marks every spawned process, so the mark is written and nothing reads it.

A CALL A LIVE REFUSAL NAMES. `page/access/modules/guards/guards.module.code.ts:18` refuses every generic write to a page-type page with the words use createPageType or patchPageTypeById. Both of those are refused by the check. The guard shuts one way in and names two calls that are not there.

A DESCRIPTION NO CODE RUNS. `story/engine/core/modules/rulebook-schema/rulebook-schema.module.code.ts:133` `parseRulebookMechanics` was the only written description of `harem-hotel.game.rulebook.json`, which sits beside a live game page, and five more in that tree were the same shape. This one read as a loose wire and was not. Alan settled that a description no code runs is not worth keeping, and all six went, the named one at `9eef62aa5c3`. Neither the check nor I could sort it; a person had to.

DATA NOTHING READS. `green-day-points` is declared on `persona/persona.page-type.ts:114` and carried with a value on the persona pages. Two readers take it and nothing takes either of them: `greenDayPointsOf` in `persona/modules/green-day-fraction/green-day-fraction.module.code.ts`, which nothing but that module's own test names, and `persona-reading.module.code.ts:85`, which puts it on a reading no caller takes that field off. Alan settled this one as an ablation, and it went at `a7444d43145` through `037a1b0a13f`.

WHAT SEPARATES THEM. A value whose absence leaves every remaining path doing exactly what it does now is an ablation. A value whose absence leaves a reader reading nothing, a guard guarding nothing, or a refusal naming what is not there is a repair. A value whose absence leaves a live file with no written description is neither until a person says, and Alan said ablation. The check answers which files name a value; it does not answer what a path expects, and no widening of it would.

WHY THIS IS NOT THE SEAT FINDING AGAIN. `a-value-nothing-names-in-the-seat-system-is-as-often-a-loose-wire-as-dead-code` states the same shape under `page-type/agent`, and a reader of that one would take it for a quirk of the seat system. It is not. It held in every tree swept.

NOT ESTABLISHED. Nothing here was run. Whether any of these was left half-wired on purpose is not recovered; no page and no commit message says.
